newsitem.title: USA: Clinton aide meets with tobacco suit participants.
newsitem.headline: Clinton aide meets with tobacco suit participants.

text.p: Presidential aide Bruce Lindsey met at the White House on Wednesday with all parties in ongoing talks to reach a tobacco settlement, according to officials who declined to discuss the negotiations.
White House spokesman Mike McCurry said the talks dealt with last week's U.S. district court ruling that the government can regulate tobacco sales and marketing, but not promotion and advertising.
President Clinton has said he will appeal the limits on government regulatory powers imposed by the court.
The White House talks also involved efforts by 24 state attorneys general who have sued the industry to recoup Medicaid costs for treating smokers.
Mounting legal pressures have forced industry representatives to try to negotiate a settlement.
